title: Flash SegaSaturn Vol. 28
native_title: フラッシュ・セガサターン Ｖｏｌ．２８
overview:
Flash SegaSaturn Vol. 28 is a free Japanese demo disc from Sega that collects a trial version and previews of Saturn games.

Playable demo:
- Super Tempo

Non-playable previews:
- Sorvice
- Shining Force III Scenario 2: Nerawareta Miko
- Shoujo Kakumei Utena: Itsuka Kakumei Sareru Monogatari
- Wachenroder
- MeltyLancer Re-inforce
- Shadows of the Tusk
- Princess Maker: Yumemiru Yousei
- Super Adventure Rockman
- Elf wo Karu Monotachi II
